description:
Submit new or changed URLs on one of the org's sites to IndexNow (api.indexnow.org), which notifies Bing, Yandex, Naver and Seznam so they can re-crawl them sooner (each engine decides when; not a guarantee of indexing). Google doesn't use IndexNow. Bing's index is one of the sources ChatGPT search and Copilot retrieve from. Sent from AuditAE's server.

Billing: free. At most 30 calls per hour per org that reach the key-file check.

When to call: after changed pages are live on a site that isn't a paired WordPress site (the AuditAE plugin already pings IndexNow on publish/update unless its auto-ping is off). Submit only URLs that changed: IndexNow throttles hosts that resubmit unchanged URLs.

Inputs:
  site_id      — the AuditAE site id (from list_sites).
  urls         — 1–100 paths ("/pricing") or absolute URLs on the site's domain or its www variant. Duplicates and #fragments are dropped, other hosts rejected.
  key_location — optional URL of an IndexNow key file the site already serves (Rank Math's, or the AuditAE plugin's "Key file" under Settings → AuditAE → AI Crawlers). Omit to use AuditAE's key for this site.

Key file: IndexNow only accepts URLs when the host serves the key at https://<host>/<key>.txt. If it isn't served, nothing is submitted and the answer is status "key_file_missing" with the filename and contents to publish; publish it, then call again.

Returns: { status: "submitted" | "not_accepted", site_id, host, key_location, submitted_urls, rejected: [{ input, reason }], duplicates_removed, batches: [{ host, url_count, http_status, ok, meaning, response }] } (http_status 200 accepted; 202 accepted, key check pending; 403 key file missing or wrong; 422 URLs don't match the host; 429 slow down) | { status: "key_file_missing", key_file: { url, filename, contents, content_type }, found, how_to_fix, wordpress? } | { status: "no_valid_urls", rejected } | { error: "site_not_found" | "rate_limited" }.

key_location.description: Optional URL of an IndexNow key file the site already serves, e.g. https://example.com/<key>.txt.

urls.description: 1–100 changed paths or absolute URLs on the site's domain (or www variant).

name: submit_urls
title: Tell Bing and other IndexNow engines that pages changed
